crop up: Small problems always seem to crop up when we try to finish a group project the night before.
每次我們想在前一晚完成小組報告時，小問題似乎總是會突然出現。
crop a photo: Before posting it online, she decided to crop a photo so that her messy bedroom would not show.
在上傳到網路前，她決定裁切照片，這樣她凌亂的房間就不會被看到。
problems cropped up: The trip went smoothly at first, but several problems cropped up when our train was suddenly canceled.
旅程一開始很順利，但當我們的火車突然被取消時，冒出了好幾個問題。
cross one's mind: It never crossed my mind that my best friend might be upset about the joke I made.
我從來沒想過（從未閃過腦海）我最好的朋友可能會因為我開的玩笑而不高興。
cross the line: Teasing a friend is fine, but you cross the line when you laugh at his family in public.
跟朋友開玩笑沒關係，但當你在公開場合嘲笑他的家人時，你就越界了。
cross one's fingers: The results come out tomorrow, so I will cross my fingers and hope I passed the exam.
成績明天公布，所以我會祈求好運，希望我通過了考試。
cross swords with: The new manager often crosses swords with the older staff over how the company should be run.
新經理常常和資深員工為了公司該如何經營而交鋒。
cross out: If you make a mistake on the form, just cross out the wrong word and write the correct one.
如果你在表格上寫錯了，只要把錯的字劃掉，再寫上正確的字就好。
get one's wires crossed: We must have got our wires crossed, because I waited at the library while she waited at the cafe.
我們一定是誤會了，因為我在圖書館等，而她卻在咖啡廳等。
be crowned champion: After winning every match this season, our school team was crowned champion of the national tournament.
在這一季贏得每場比賽後，我們校隊被加冕為全國錦標賽的冠軍。
crown the achievement: Winning the gold medal at the Olympics would crown the achievement of her long and successful career.
在奧運贏得金牌將為她漫長而成功的職業生涯的成就畫下完美句點。
crowning glory: The beautiful garden behind the old house is its crowning glory, and visitors always take photos there.
老房子後面那座美麗的花園是它的最高榮耀，遊客總是在那裡拍照。
the economy crumbled: When the war broke out, the economy crumbled, and many families could no longer afford basic food.
戰爭爆發時，經濟崩解，許多家庭再也買不起基本的食物。
the empire crumbled: After years of weak rulers and endless wars, the empire crumbled and split into several small kingdoms.
經過多年軟弱的統治者和無止盡的戰爭，帝國瓦解並分裂成幾個小王國。
resistance crumbled: After weeks of fighting without food or supplies, the rebels' resistance crumbled and they finally surrendered.
在沒有食物和補給的情況下戰鬥了好幾週後，叛軍的抵抗瓦解，他們終於投降了。
crumble under pressure: Even top students may crumble under pressure, losing all confidence and forgetting everything during the big exam.
即使是頂尖的學生也可能在壓力下崩潰，在大考時失去所有信心並忘光一切。
crush the rebellion: The king sent thousands of soldiers to crush the rebellion, and within a week it was completely over.
國王派出數千名士兵鎮壓叛亂，不到一週叛亂就完全結束了。
crush one's hopes: The injury before the final game crushed his hopes of playing for the national team this year.
決賽前的受傷粉碎了他今年為國家隊出賽的希望。
be crushed by the news: She was crushed by the news that her best friend was moving abroad, and she cried all night.
她被最好的朋友要搬到國外的消息擊垮了，哭了一整晚。
have a crush on: Everyone in class knows that Tom has a crush on Amy because he always blushes when she talks.
班上每個人都知道湯姆暗戀艾咪，因為她一說話他就會臉紅。
crush the opponent: Our basketball team played so well last night that we were able to crush the opponent by forty points.
我們的籃球隊昨晚打得非常好，以四十分之差大勝對手。
cultivate a habit: If you want to improve your English, try to cultivate a habit of reading a short article every day.
如果你想提升英文，試著培養每天讀一篇短文的習慣。
cultivate relationships: A good salesperson carefully cultivates relationships with customers by remembering their names and needs.
好的業務員會藉由記住顧客的名字和需求，用心經營人脈。
cultivate talent: The music school was founded to cultivate talent in young children from poor families in the countryside.
這所音樂學校是為了培育鄉下貧困家庭孩子的人才而創立的。
cultivate the land: For generations, the farmers in this valley have cultivated the land to grow rice and vegetables.
好幾代以來，這座山谷的農夫都耕地種植稻米和蔬菜。
curb inflation: The government raised interest rates to curb inflation, hoping that prices would stop rising so quickly.
政府調升利率以抑制通膨，希望物價不要漲得那麼快。
curb spending: To save enough money for a new bike, she decided to curb spending on snacks and drinks.
為了存夠錢買新腳踏車，她決定控制在零食和飲料上的開支。
curb one's temper: He is trying hard to curb his temper, so he counts to ten before answering when he feels angry.
他正努力克制脾氣，所以生氣時會先數到十再回答。
curb emissions: Many countries have promised to curb emissions of carbon dioxide in order to slow down global warming.
許多國家承諾減少二氧化碳的排放，以減緩全球暖化。
